blurb: Estrella Warbirds Museum brings together rare military aircraft and the remarkable men and women who flew them, preserving their stories so they're never forgotten. The museum also features the Woodland Auto Display with vintage, classic, and historic automobiles, emphasizing race cars. Visitors can explore exhibits and attend special events honoring veterans and first responders.
